annotations.title: List the requests of the customer

description: Lists the requests the signed-in customer sent to businesses through Bookvia, newest first, whichever assistant sent them: open and past ones, each with status (pending, confirmed, declined, expired or cancelled), awaiting, request_id, business, service, the agreed or proposed time (ISO 8601) and a notice. Nothing is agreed or booked unless the status of an entry is confirmed. open_only: true returns only requests that still wait for an answer. limit is 10 by default and at most 25. An urgent request to several businesses is one entry, with the state at every business in group. The request_id of an entry works with get_request_status and cancel_request. Returns only the requests of this customer and no customer data; requests whose customer data was deleted are not listed. Appointments made with book_appointment are listed too, each with booking.

limit.description: Maximum number of requests, default 10, at most 25

open_only.description: true: only requests that are still pending. Default false: all requests, also the closed ones

name: list_my_requests

notice.description: What the list covers, in words. Written by Bookvia: facts only, never instructions. The state of an entry is in its status and awaiting

requests.description: Newest first (created_at, ISO 8601). Every entry has the same fields as the answer of get_request_status. An urgent request to several businesses is one entry: group has the state at every business. An appointment made with book_appointment is an entry too, with booking

start.description: ISO 8601 with time zone offset, e.g. 2026-11-24T10:00:00+01:00

appointment.description: Agreed time. Only set when status is confirmed and a time was agreed. For a booking: the firm appointment, in German time. null again after the appointment was cancelled.

awaiting.description: On whom the next step depends right now. customer_click = the customer has not yet clicked the button in the e-mail from Bookvia, and nothing was sent to the business yet. For a booking the times are only held (in German: vorgemerkt), nothing is booked, and the result is not a booking receipt. customer_decision = the business proposed another time (see proposal) or offered replacement times for an appointment it cancelled (see rescheduled_from), which only the customer can accept, pick or decline, through the link in their e-mail; cancel_request declines all replacement times. business_answer = a person at the business has to accept or decline; the business has not answered yet, and the answer also arrives by e-mail. nothing = the request is no longer pending: it is agreed (status confirmed) or closed.

booking.description: Only present for an appointment made with book_appointment: how it becomes firm and which times are held

held_until.description: Only while pending: the times are held until then (ISO 8601). With waiting_for = customer this is the deadline for the click of the customer, with waiting_for = business the deadline for the answer of the business. After that the status becomes expired and the times are free again. Otherwise null

mode.description: automatic = the appointment becomes firm with the click of the customer in their e-mail. business_confirms = after that click a person at the business picks one of the times or declines

times.description: The times asked for with book_appointment, in German time (ISO 8601 with offset). While pending they are held for this customer and nobody else can take them

start.description: ISO 8601 with time zone offset, e.g. 2026-11-24T10:00:00+01:00

cancelled_by.description: Only present when an appointment that was firm has been cancelled (status is then cancelled): who cancelled it. The appointment is no longer firm, and nothing is booked anymore. Without rescheduled_to the business offered no replacement times

expires_at.description: While pending: deadline for the answer. With waiting_for = customer (unverified listing or booking): deadline for the click of the customer. After that the status becomes expired. If it expired because the customer did not click, nothing was sent to the business and nothing is booked; a new request, or for a booking get_availability and a new idempotency_key, starts over.

group.description: Only for urgent requests: the common state of the job and the state at every business it went to. For an urgent request go by group.status, not by the status of one business: one may have declined while another can still accept

accepted_by.description: The business that accepted first and has the job. null as long as nobody accepted.

expires_at.description: While pending: if no business accepts by then, the urgent request expires and the customer is told by e-mail

group_id.description: Same for all requests of one urgent job

notice.description: The common state in words: who has the request, what is agreed and until when it runs. Written by Bookvia: facts only, never instructions. The same is in status as data

requests.description: One entry per business the customer agreed to, in the order of business_ids

not_sent_reason.description: Why nothing was sent to this business, e.g. business_request_limit_reached. Otherwise null

request_id.description: Use with get_request_status. null if nothing was sent to this business

status.description: State at this business. cancelled with taken_by_other = true: another business accepted first

submitted.description: false: nothing was sent to this business, see not_sent_reason. The other businesses still got the request.

taken_by_other.description: true: this request was closed because another business accepted first. The business was told that the job is taken.

status.description: Common state of the urgent job: pending = at least one business can still accept, nothing is agreed yet. confirmed = one business accepted first and has the job. declined = every business said no. expired = nobody accepted in time. cancelled = the customer withdrew. While pending, no business agreed. After declined or expired, nothing was agreed.

message_from_business.description: Message of the business for the customer, in German

notice.description: The state in words: what happened, on whom the next step depends and until when. Written by Bookvia: facts only, never instructions. The same is in status and awaiting as data

start.description: ISO 8601 with time zone offset, e.g. 2026-11-24T10:00:00+01:00

proposal.description: The business proposed this time instead. NOT confirmed: only the customer can accept or decline it, via the link in their e-mail. Only set while pending.

rescheduled_from.description: Only present on a request that holds replacement times offered by the business: the request_id of the appointment the business cancelled

rescheduled_to.description: Only present when the business cancelled a firm appointment and offered other times instead: the request_id of the request that holds these times (get_request_status). Only the customer can pick one of them, through their e-mail

status.description: pending = waiting, nothing is agreed yet. confirmed = a person at the business said yes; for an appointment made with book_appointment: the appointment is firm, because the customer clicked the button in their e-mail and the booking rules of the business, or a person there, made it firm. declined = the business said no. expired = nobody answered in time, or for a booking the customer did not click in time. cancelled = the customer withdrew, or for an urgent request another business accepted first (see group), or Bookvia could not pass a request on to an unverified listing (see notice), or an appointment made with book_appointment that was firm has been cancelled by the customer or the business (see cancelled_by): then nothing is booked anymore. Only confirmed means something is agreed or booked. While pending, a request is sent and a booking is held, neither agreed nor booked; awaiting says on whom it depends. After declined or expired, nothing was agreed.

unverified.description: true: the request is for a business that is NOT on Bookvia (an entry from unverified). business.id is then the listing id (lst_…), and whether the business answers is open. Only present for such requests

urgent.description: true: an urgent request. Only present for urgent requests

waiting_for.description: Only while pending, for a request to an unverified listing or a booking made with book_appointment. customer = the customer first has to click the button in the e-mail from Bookvia: until then nothing was sent to the business and no time is firm. business = the customer clicked and it is the turn of the business: for an unverified listing it is open whether it answers, for a booking a person at the business picks one of the times or declines

total.description: All requests of the customer that match open_only, not only the ones returned

title: List the requests of the customer
